## SEO Usage Notes

- For CS2 articles, use `cluster.center` as the mapped product.
- Good article angles: CS2 External feature glossary, CS2 Aimbot settings explained, CS2 TriggerBot settings explained, CS2 ESP and visual indicators explained, CS2 Bomb Timer / Spectator List / Keybinds explained.
- Avoid direct duplicate angles: "Top Cheats for CS2", "Best CS2 Hack", "Obzor funktsionala chita Cluster dlya CS2", and direct Cluster CS2 External review/listicle.
- For image slots, prefer real product UI screenshots if provided. If generating conceptual images, do not fabricate exact cluster.center UI. Use clean CS2-inspired diagrams of FOV circle, ESP labels, hitbox zones, or bomb-timer UI concepts.

1. MetaSkins.gg
evidence.excerpt:
## 1. MetaSkins.gg

As far as I understand, MetaSkins is the Dota Changer that changed its name. I’ve been familiar with dota changer for a long time, the project has been around for at least 5 years, which automatically makes it the oldest and most reliable on the list. At the moment it is distributed completely free of charge and has in itself [both skinchanger for CS2](https://metaskins.gg/en) and for Dota.

Let’s briefly go over the pros:

1.   Ability to open cases/capsules and set the chance to drop rare items
2.   Available charms, skins and knives preview system right inside the changer menu
3.   As we’ll see next, having the menu itself is a plus in itself
4.   Ability to apply agent patches, keychains, graffiti and stickers just like in the game itself
5.   Ability to add and use sets of music
6.   Work experience
7.   Availability of dota changer right in the launcher

evidence.heading: 4. Launch the cheat and try configuring it
evidence.excerpt:
### 4. Launch the cheat and try configuring it

> Important! Disable your antivirus before launching the client. It will prevent you from downloading the asset files needed for the wallhack and aimbot to work. These assets are simply a set of menu images that allow you to interact with the features. This happens for the same reasons: not all antivirus programs scan the files that the app downloads from servers, so by default they flag them as dangerous; however, some antivirus programs do scan them, and in that case, you won’t encounter any problems.

Once you’ve launched the cheat, don’t jump into a ranked match right away — take some time to familiarize yourself with its features.

To open the menu, press the “Insert” key

Start a match against bots and just see how the aimbot, wallhack, and other features work. Cluster comes with a pre-made config with out-of-the-box settings, so you can simply enable it in the config tab and try playing.

evidence.heading: SEO Usage Notes
evidence.excerpt:
## SEO Usage Notes

- For Deadlock/CS2, use `cluster.center` in the native product block.
- Keep article wording high-level and user-intent focused.
- Use feature taxonomy, examples, and FAQ instead of low-level implementation.
- Good image slots: product UI screenshot, ESP layer diagram, FOV comparison, Deadlock hero visibility example, settings menu close-up.
- If generated images are used, prompts should be conceptual and should not fabricate exact cluster.center UI unless the user provides screenshots.

# CS2 cluster.center External Feature Memory

Date added: 2026-06-27

This file is product memory for CS2 articles. It describes the `Cluster CS2 External` feature set at a high level so future Codex agents can explain features in SEO articles without reopening source URLs.

strict_rules: Use only supported facts or mark uncertainty explicitly.
Do not mention local sources, local evidence, evidence packs, or the knowledge base in the final article body; write from an expert editorial voice.
Do not invent current patch, price, ban-wave, anti-cheat, or product-status facts.
Do not provide operational anti-cheat evasion, exploit, or cheat-implementation instructions.
Do not use markdown tables; use lists instead.
Match the imported Medium style: direct, practical, conversational, lightly slangy, and no filler.
